title: CAN bus and ESP32 TWAI: automotive and industrial networks

spans.text: CAN is a noise-tolerant differential, message-based bus used in vehicle ECUs, industrial control, and robotics. ESP32 calls its CAN 2.0 controller peripheral TWAI; controller pins cannot connect directly to CAN wiring.

spans.caption: CAN bus and ESP32 TWAI: automotive and industrial networks

spans.title: Important note
spans.text: A separate CAN transceiver is required. Terminate both ends of the CANH/CANL bus with 120 Ω as specified by the topology. This is an ESP-IDF API example, not CAN-FD; test with two nodes at matching bit rates.
